description: Group, money, and logistics subsystems: people/headcount manager (5-15) with RSVP + realtime; expense splitter (who paid, who owes, running balances, settle-up) with realtime sync; shared budget tracker mapped to the document's priced/not-priced list; driver-rotation tracker with the 'rotate only rested drivers' warning; shared checkable packing/checklist seeded with NPS winter gear; document vault via Supabase Storage; weather/road reminder cards; open-decisions tracker seeded from the document. Depends on FEAT-002 (repository + realtime + storage) and FEAT-003 (shell + ui primitives).
steps: Group: src/app/(app)/group/page.tsx + src/components/group/* — people list supporting 5 to 15 entries with RSVP status (going/maybe/no), add/remove, headcount summary; subscribe to realtime updates when supabaseAvailable, else mock-store. Seeded with the 4 adults.

Money: src/app/(app)/money/page.tsx + src/components/expenses/* + src/lib/money/split.ts — expense splitter (payer, participants, amount) computing running balances and settle-up suggestions (pure functions in split.ts); realtime sync of expenses. src/components/budget/* — budget tracker with categories mapped to the document (fuel, parking, $35 park fee, hotels, food) marking priced vs not-priced. src/components/drivers/* — driver-rotation tracker surfacing the 'rotate only rested drivers' warning.

Logistics: src/app/(app)/logistics/page.tsx + src/components/checklist/* (packing list seeded with NPS winter gear: layers, food, water, scraper, flashlight, over-shoe traction; checkable, realtime), src/components/vault/* (upload hotel/booking confirmations to the Supabase Storage 'documents' bucket; degrade to a local-only list with disabled upload when Storage unavailable), src/components/weather/* (24-48h Grand Canyon forecast/road-check reminder cards from seed), src/components/decisions/* (open-decisions tracker seeded with the 3 document decisions: drive whole route?, whole-trip budget, Jan 1 return leg; status editable).
Add a single vitest test for src/lib/money/split.ts if vitest is introduced (balances and settle-up correctness); otherwise verify via render. Keep it minimal.
Commit locally: `git add -A && git commit -m "feat: group, expense splitter, budget, drivers, and logistics"`.
acceptance_criteria: Group list renders the 4 seed adults and supports adding up to 15 with RSVP in mock mode.
Adding an expense split across people produces correct running balances (manually verify one example, e.g. one payer of $100 across 4 people -> each owes $25).

Budget tracker shows the document's categories with priced/not-priced flags; drivers panel shows the rested-drivers warning; checklist shows the NPS winter-gear items and toggles; decisions show the 3 seeded open decisions.
`npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run build` pass with no .env.local; vitest (if added) passes.
verification: cd d:\Personal-Projects\trip-site; npm run lint; npx tsc --noEmit; npm run build  (no .env.local)
npm run dev; exercise group add, one expense split, checklist toggle, decisions render
npx vitest run src/lib/money  (only if vitest was added)
